release_notes: Performance & Cage speed-ups, plus anonymous update stats. PERFORMANCE: the C++ math core behind HP/LP matching now uses a spatial-grid nearest-neighbour search instead of brute force - the heavy distance passes run 5-18x faster on dense meshes, with identical results; rebuilt with AVX2 + link-time optimization for every supported Maya version (2022-2027). CAGE: Create Cage is now near-instant even on chapters with many subgroups - cages are built in one batched pass (a single duplicate and a single shading assignment) instead of one-by-one, and deflated cages skip redundant per-vertex work; added a progress bar during the build and an automatic viewport refresh so new cages appear immediately without nudging the camera. ANONYMOUS STATS: starting with this version the tool sends a tiny, fully anonymous ping on update - a random id (not tied to you), the tool version, your Maya version and the UI language. Nothing else: no names, no files, no scene data. It only shows how many artists use the tool and which Maya versions to keep supporting.
